correctness.rationale: Every truth set is an upset. Local box/diamond evaluation on a final segment is exactly determined by maximal neighbourhood minima and minimal neighbourhood maxima, including the two distinct empty-family sentinels. All possible local signature pairs have explicit representatives of size at most two. Continuality forces empty neighbourhood families into an initial segment, and its index is detected by the box threshold. The three disjoint negative-diamond prefix cases yield the binomial count by stars-and-bars and Vandermonde convolution. A top-world signature with box threshold above diamond threshold proves the two-family bound sharp. Code run on the actual included verify.py passed all local cases through three worlds, all global local-profile words through four worlds, 4,800 nested formula tests, and closed-form vs independent recurrence through eight worlds. No finite computation is substituted for the quantified proof.

Conversely, the present result does not improve their axiomatization or full-frame decidability conclusions.

originality.rationale: A statement-level comparison with the complete available semantic sections of the 2025 de Groot and 2026 Dalmonte–de Groot primary papers did not find the fixed-chain joint operator quotient, the sharp two-family reduction, or the explicit binomial spectrum. Closest finite relational-core and modal-cover reductions rest on stronger or different hypotheses and do not imply the witness and census here. Multiple published-finding corpus and literature searches for equivalent terms, broader coverage, exact numeric tables and claimed implications were run. Novelty assessment remains provisional to independent checking; unindexed algebraic restatements may exist.

value.rationale: Continual constructive neighbourhood semantics is a core semantics for an active intuitionistic monotone modal logic, and finite Gödel chains are canonical test algebras. Unlike a cosmetic truncation, the theorem preserves the full nested two-modal language, is globally sharp, and gives a closed all-size enumeration of the joint operation spectrum. The switch between the two empty-family endpoints creates a nontrivial boundary condition in the exact counting formula. This is a natural complete structural classification useful as a finite semantic benchmark; no broader paper-sized application is assumed.
